commentary.text: 90+9' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+7' Yeremy Pino pings in the corner towards the centre of the box and finds Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) unmarked, but his free header is woeful and slips well over the bar.
90+7' The referee awards a corner and Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) goes over to take it.

90+6' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) is first to latch onto the rebound inside the penalty area. He sends a promising shot towards the bottom left corner, but it is denied by the goalkeeper who pulls off a superb save. Crystal Palace will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
90+5' Joel Veltman (Brighton) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.
90+3' Maxim De Cuyper (Brighton) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
90+2' Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton) sends the corner into the box, but Dean Henderson intercepts it and averts the threat.
90+1' Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
90+1' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
88' Corner kicks – 3:6.
85' Substitution. Diego Gomez will be replaced by Maxim De Cuyper (Brighton).
85' Fabian Hurzeler has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Stefanos Tzimas (Brighton) replacing Danny Welbeck.
83' Here comes a substitution. Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) is brought on as a substitute for Daichi Kamada.
82' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.

80' Diego Gomez (Brighton) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace will have a goal kick.
80' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
78' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
77' The ball is cleared after Charalampos Kostoulas (Brighton) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play. Brighton are awarded a corner kick.
76' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
76' Joel Veltman (Brighton) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Brighton.
75' Fabian Hurzeler has decided to make a change. Joel Veltman (Brighton) replaces Carlos Baleba.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Charalampos Kostoulas (Brighton) replaces Georginio Rutter.
74' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) offside.
72' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) amazingly found his way through the defence, but lacked a precise finish as his effort from close range went slightly wide of the left post.
72' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) is able to continue to play.
71' Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Dean Henderson intercepts the ball.
70' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
69' 6:5 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The shots on goal statistics – 1:3.
66' The substitution has been made. Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) has replaced Adam Wharton.
65' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
65' The Brighton players are stunned as referee Tim Robinson changes his mind after a VAR review. NO PENALTY! Play to continue.
63' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Brighton using VAR. Let's see what happens.

63' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Tim Robinson blows his whistle for an infringement. It's a penalty! What an opportunity to score for Brighton.
60' This is a yellow card! Carlos Baleba (Brighton) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
58' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Danny Welbeck.

55' A pass into the penalty area from Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) is intercepted by the defence. The ball rebounds off the defender into the path of Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace), who immediately strikes for goal from inside the box but sends it a whisker wide of the left post.
54' Brighton enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
50' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) takes the corner but it's cleared.
47' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.

46' Diego Gomez (Brighton) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the right side of the goal. Dean Henderson shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
46' The whistle blows and Tim Robinson starts the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) cushions the ball on his chest then hits a first-time volley well wide of the right post from inside the box.
45+1' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
45+1' CHANCE! Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he sends his shot well wide of the right post.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
40' A rebound bounces out to Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) on the edge of the box, but he can't control his shot and it slips well wide of the right post.
38' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
36' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) whips in a cross from the corner, but Dean Henderson is well positioned and punches the ball away.
35' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
33' A player from Crystal Palace commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
32' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 3:2. The current number of shots on goal is 1:2.
32' The corner from Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) is intercepted by Bart Verbruggen.
31' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
28' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
28' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. A free kick has been awarded to Crystal Palace.
26' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
25' Mats Wieffer (Brighton) sends a long cross over to Danny Welbeck, but Dean Henderson comes forward to gather the ball.
22' Tim Robinson blows for a foul after Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
20' The resulting corner, taken by Yankuba Minteh (Brighton), comes to nothing.
19' Diego Gomez (Brighton) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. Now Brighton have a corner.
17' The possession of the ball – 32:68.
15' Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
13' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
13' Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) had an opportunity from long range. His low shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Dean Henderson was alert and made a comfortable save.
12' Fabian Hurzeler appears to have said too much and referee Tim Robinson comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
11' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
10' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
10' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

9' A sweet pass finds Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the right side of the goal. Bart Verbruggen is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. The referee points to the corner flag and Crystal Palace will take a corner.
8' Diego Gomez (Brighton) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and sends a shot to the left side of the goal, but is denied by a reflex save from Dean Henderson.
8' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

7' A lofted cross from Mats Wieffer (Brighton) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Brighton.
6' Jaydee Canvot (Crystal Palace) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Tim Robinson blows his whistle for a foul.
4' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the right post.
3' Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Brighton will have the kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to ceremony.
Tim Robinson is introduced as the referee for today's match.
